functions.name: allocateZeroedArray
functions.notes: Multiplies count by element size in 64 bits. Below the 65536 threshold only the low word is used; above it an overflowing product requests 0xffffffff bytes. A null malloc result is returned as null. Zero fill is skipped when malloc header flags say the block is already zero.

validation.comparison: Twelve count/size pairs cover zero counts, small allocations, both sides of the 65536 truncation threshold, 64-bit overflow and a large successful allocation. Each compares the block pointer, all 67,108,864 memory bytes and the stack pointer.
limitations: malloc 368 remains native; 382 fillMemory is selected as a native dependency at the oracle level.
Ledger: 438 client bodies recovered and 3,807 remain machine code.
